description: This file defines the Drupal Core Url class, which manages URL objects within Drupal, including creation, parsing, and access control for URLs with various schemes (internal, route, entity, external).

classes.name: Url
classes.description: Represents and manages URLs in Drupal, supporting various schemes and providing methods for URL creation, parsing, access control, and string representation.

methods.name: fromRoute
methods.description: Creates a URL object for a Drupal route.

methods.name: fromRouteMatch
methods.description: Creates a URL object from a route match object.

methods.name: fromUserInput
methods.description: Creates a URL object from user input, handling relative paths, query strings, and fragments.

methods.name: fromUri
methods.description: Creates a URL object from a URI with various schemes (internal, entity, base, route, external).

methods.name: createFromRequest
methods.description: Creates a URL object matching the current request.
